title: Three Harvests and One Short Sack
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：grain　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the miller ① ground the grain that no farmer in the valley would have described, and he said the grinding was the whole of the harvest. The ② grain, meaning the seed itself and not the flour, ran three harvests and stayed undescribed in the book; grain, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of grain in that valley had the same short sack beside it, and the ④ grain at the far loft, meaning the store they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Grain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the miller said the describing is the part that fills three harvests.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grain was the whole of the matter, meaning the texture and not the seed. The ⑥ grain, meaning the texture and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grain, he said, is either something you grind or the only word that means both a seed and a texture. He said the texture is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ grain had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short sack. The ⑧ grain of the whole thing, the miller wrote in November, was one valley and three harvests of describing; grain, he said, is either the store at the far loft or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grain I remember is the grain described in the ledger, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Grain, my mother said in 1972, is the only seed that improves by being described; all grain, she said, is a texture that has agreed to look like a seed. She said the texture was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 谷物；粮食（指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 谷物；谷粒（指那种种子本身，与面粉相对）
C. 固定搭配：grind the grain 磨谷物
D. n. 谷物（指留给孩子们看的那批存粮）
E. n. 粮食（抽象总称，指一处山谷的谷物之事）
F. n. 谷物（指账簿里写到、被称过的那批）
G. n. 纹理；质地（the grain of the wood，指一件事里人人都摸却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 纹理（抽象总称，指人人都摸却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ground the grain that no farmer in the valley would have described
The grain, meaning the seed itself and not the flour
Every kind of grain in that valley
the grain at the far loft
the grain was the whole of the matter
the grain had become a line in a ledger
The grain of the whole thing

answers.why: grind the grain 意为“磨谷物”，1963 年那位磨坊主磨了山谷里没有一位农夫肯描述的谷物。
grain 意为“谷物、谷粒”，指那种种子本身而不是面粉，它经过了三个收获季而在簿子上没有被描述。
grain 意为“谷物、粮食”，指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只矮矮的口袋。
grain 意为“谷物”，指最远那间阁楼上留给孩子们看的那批存粮，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grain 意为“纹理、质地”，指一件事里人人都摸却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道纹理就是那件事的全部。
grain 意为“纹理”，指人人都摸却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些谷物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grain 意为“谷物”，指账簿里写到、被称过的那批，到 1968 年这批成了账簿里的一行。
grain 意为“粮食”，磨坊主十一月写道，整件事的谷物之事是一处山谷和三个收获季的描述。
grain 意为“谷物”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那批，1970 年磨完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一批。
grain 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，谷物是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的种子。
